title: Two Duties, One Queen
setup: The queen on b6 holds the rook on d8 and the knight on a6, and your bishop already eyes a6.
hint: Your bishop is aimed at a defended knight. Find the defender and hand it a job it must answer.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rxd8+}} is check and {{Qxd8}} is the only answer. The queen has left the sixth rank, so {{Bxa6}} simply takes the knight. Hunt for defenders that are holding two pieces at once. A defender does not have to be captured, only given somewhere else to be.
